behaviour_contract: Charge begins at5 (air throw32), grows to63, then becomes a signed16 charge<<8 outbound budget. Upgrades select base speeds5/8/11, gold adds damage2, movement adjustment caps stored launch speed at16. Keep the separate Q4 y accumulator, +8 screen x bias, paired outbound/return substates, deceleration thresholds11/8, zero-speed reversal, crossing test and no-overshoot return steering. The collision globals ray_zdc_h/ray_zdc_y have existing reversed y-origin/height roles; use actual expressions. Carried-object release chooses initial position versus Rayman placement from force/alive state.
